Subject: Post-call: Coordinate multi-zone deep-dive + rotating demo windows

Hi Miguel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for time-sensitive routing and cost controls for HorizonGrid's internal and customer-facing features.
- Key constraints: EU data residency for EU requests, predictable sub-200ms p50 latency for priority routes, and an initial pilot across 3 teams (US ops, EU analytics, APAC platform).
- Stakeholders to include: your platform lead (Anna) for EU architecture and your SRE lead for the latency requirements.

Proposed next step: 45–60m technical deep-dive (demo + infra Q&A). Because stakeholders span US/EU/APAC, we usually run a rotating window plan so the initial sessions don't permanently disadvantage a timezone. Below are three rotating slot proposals — please pick which works best for your group, or share a couple of times and we'll adapt: 

Option A — US-friendly first week
- Week 1 (US week): Tue/Wed 10:00–11:00 PT (17:00–18:00 BST / 00:00–01:00 SGT)
- Week 2 (EU week): Tue/Wed 16:00–17:00 BST (08:00–09:00 PT / 23:00–00:00 SGT)
- Week 3 (APAC week): Wed/Thu 09:00–10:00 SGT (17:00–18:00 PT / 01:00–02:00 BST)

Option B — Fair-rotation (each session moves forward one week):
- Session 1: Mon 09:00 PT (17:00 BST / 00:00 SGT)
- Session 2: Mon 17:00 BST (09:00 PT / 00:00 SGT)
- Session 3: Tue 09:00 SGT (17:00 PT / 01:00 BST)

Option C — Single time (if you prefer one consistent window): Wed 14:00 PT (22:00 BST / 05:00 SGT) — we avoid this if EU stakeholders need normal business hours.

I've attached a short deep-dive outline and a sample rotating-timeband schedule (redwood-deepdive-outline.pdf, rotating-timeband-proposal.xlsx). If helpful, here's a Calendly link to pick a slot and auto-include the EU tech lead: https://calendly.com/redwood/deep-dive-45m

Please loop in Anna or whomever should be at the table and tell me which option you prefer — I can then send a calendar invite and include Monica (solutions engineer) for the demo and Karthik (sales engineering) for the architecture Q&A.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
